name: biobb_gromacs MdrunMultidir
title: Wrapper of the GROMACS mdrun module for multidir setups.
description: MDRun is the main computational chemistry engine within GROMACS. It performs Molecular Dynamics simulations, but it can also perform Stochastic Dynamics, Energy Minimization, test particle insertion or (re)calculation of energies.

input_tpr_path.description: Path to the portable binary run input file TPR in each of the subdirectories

file_formats.description: Path to the portable binary run input file TPR in each of the subdirectories

input_multifolder.description: Path to the folder with all subdirectories for the multidir setup

file_formats.description: Path to the folder with all subdirectories for the multidir setup

output_multifolder.description: Folder where the generated output files will be saved

file_formats.description: Folder where the generated output files will be saved

mpi_bin.description: Path to the MPI runner. Usually "mpirun" or "srun".

mpi_np.description: Number of MPI processes. Usually an integer bigger than 1.

mpi_flags.description: Path to the MPI hostlist file.

noappend.description: Include the noappend flag to open new output files and add the simulation part number to all output file names

num_threads.description: Let GROMACS guess. The number of threads that are going to be used.

num_threads_mpi.description: Let GROMACS guess. The number of GROMACS MPI threads that are going to be used.

num_threads_omp.description: Let GROMACS guess. The number of GROMACS OPENMP threads that are going to be used. If bigger than 0, OMP_NUM_THREADS is also set to this value for the mdrun process only, replacing any value inherited from the environment or set in env_vars_dict.

num_threads_omp_pme.description: Let GROMACS guess. The number of GROMACS OPENMP_PME threads that are going to be used.

use_gpu.description: Use settings appropriate for GPU. Adds: -nb gpu -pme gpu

gpu_id.description: list of unique GPU device IDs available to use.

gpu_tasks.description: list of GPU device IDs, mapping each PP task on each node to a device.

gmx_lib.description: Path set GROMACS GMXLIB environment variable.

binary_path.description: Path to the GROMACS executable binary.

gmx_nobackup.description: Add the -nobackup flag: GROMACS overwrites the existing files without backing them up.

gmx_nocopyright.description: Add the -nocopyright flag: GROMACS does not print its copyright and citation header.

restart.description: Do not execute if output files exist.

sandbox_path.description: Parent path to the sandbox directory.

container_path.description: Path to the binary executable of your container.

container_volume_path.description: Path to an internal directory in the container.

container_user_id.description: User number id to be mapped inside the container.

container_shell_path.description: Path to the binary executable of the container shell.
